headline: Body of missing Massachusetts boater recovered off York, Maine
dek: Marine Patrol and local rescuers recovered Chester Benjamin Wiggins, 84, after a multiday search that began when his overturned boat was found near Cape Neddick.
body: Maine Marine Patrol and York Fire Department rescue swimmers recovered the body of an 84-year-old Bedford, Massachusetts, man Friday after a multiday search off York, the Maine Department of Marine Resources said.

The agency identified the man as Chester Benjamin Wiggins. A witness reported finding his body about 150 feet from shore near Ocean Avenue Extension at roughly 1:30 p.m., according to the department. The body was taken to the Office of Chief Medical Examiner.

The search began Wednesday after a local resident found Wiggins' overturned 17-foot Boston Whaler near the Cape Neddick Nubble Light. He had last been seen Tuesday evening aboard the boat in Cape Neddick Harbor, the department said.

Friday's search included Maine Marine Patrol, York police and fire departments, and the York County Emergency Management Agency's drone team. Marine Patrol said it will investigate the cause of the incident in the coming weeks.
author: NorthEast News Desk
